title: Mysterious Potion
body:
"Drink at your own risk."

The Mysterious Potion is a potion that's available to purchase for $1300 at the Oak Depot. The Mysterious Potion can be found in the back of the store, next to the furnace-like object, and behind two stacked crates on the right. It will be inside of a miniature crate, likely made to blend in.

The Mysterious potion can be used to teleport randomly around the map, even spots like the Moon or clouds.
